title: The Runaway Returns
paragraphs: What's up? It's Paul, currently grounded for Jesus, chilling with my bro Timothy. This shout-out goes to my main man Philemon, my partner in crime for the cause. And what up to Apphia, our homegirl, and Archippus, a total beast. Big props to the whole squad that meets at your place. Hope God's dropping nothing but blessings on you. Christ's blessings on you!

Every time I'm praying, I give God a major shout-out for you. For real, the gossip going around is that your love and faith for the big boss, Jesus, is so strong it's spilling over and getting on everyone else. I keep praying that the faith we all share makes you do awesome stuff, so everyone can see Jesus's transformation in us. Listen, you have no idea how hyped your love makes me. It's like a breath of fresh air when I see how you're a real one to other believers.

So, speaking of all that, I've got a favor to ask. As Jesus's top agent, and since I'm literally in jail for him, I could totally pull rank and order you to do this. But nah, I'd rather just ask you, man to man.

While I've been locked up, I kind of became a dad to this guy, and now I'm sending him to you with this letter. His name is Onesimus! Yeah, I know, he was totally useless to you before, but now he's a real MVP for both of us. I'm sending him back, and it feels like I'm chopping off my own arm. I seriously wanted to keep him here to help me out while I'm stuck in this cell for spreading the Word. But I didn't want to do you dirty and make you do a good thing that you didn't 100% agree to.

Maybe him ghosting you for a while was all part of the plan. You're getting him back for good now—and he's not just some servant anymore, he's a legit brother in Christ! That's what he is to me, and he's gonna be even more of a bro to you.

So if you still see me as your ride-or-die, welcome him back just like you'd welcome me. If he wrecked anything or owes you cash, just put it on my tab. I'm signing this myself—Paul—and I'm good for it. (And hey, let's not forget you basically owe me your life, right?) So do me this solid, my friend. You'll be doing it for Jesus, but it'll make me feel awesome too.

I know you're a real one, so I'm sure you'll do it. You'll probably even do more than I'm asking. Oh, and by the way, get the guest room ready. With all your prayers, I'm totally planning on crashing with you again soon.
Epaphras, my cellmate in this whole Jesus thing, says 'sup. And so do my coworkers Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke. Peace out from the boss, Jesus Christ!
